model_organism.citation: Ap2s1 mutation causes hypercalcaemia in mice and impairs interaction between calcium-sensing receptor and adaptor protein-2 (PMID: 33729479)
phenotypes: no alterations in bone mineral density
impaired AP2σ2 interaction with other AP2 subunits

model_organism.citation: N-ethyl-N-nitrosourea-Induced Adaptor Protein 2 Sigma Subunit 1 (Ap2s1) Mutations Establish Ap2s1 Loss-of-Function Mice (PMID: 29479578)
phenotypes: normal plasma calcium, phosphate, magnesium, creatinine, urea, sodium, potassium
normal urinary fractional excretion of calcium, phosphate, sodium, potassium

model_organism.citation: The adaptor protein 2 (AP2) complex modulates habituation and behavioral selection across multiple pathways and time windows (PMID: 38550987)
phenotypes: deficits in acoustically evoked habituation learning
reduced action selection across sensory contexts
acute nervous system effects on habituation

model_organism.citation: Integration of cooperative and opposing molecular programs drives learning-associated behavioral plasticity (PMID: 36972301)
phenotypes: antagonizes dopamine signaling in habituation regulation

model_organism.citation: A Forward Genetic Screen in Zebrafish Identifies the G-Protein-Coupled Receptor CaSR as a Modulator of Sensorimotor Decision Making (PMID: 29681477)
phenotypes: impaired behavioral response selection to acoustic stimuli

biological.citation: The HAVCR1-centric host factor network drives Zika virus vertical transmission (PMID: 40156834)
biological.summary: AP2S1 cooperates with HAVCR1 for ZIKV internalization through clathrin-mediated endocytosis, as revealed by proteomic profiling and functional analyses. AP2S1 is identified as a key component in the viral entry pathway.

biological.citation: N-ethyl-N-nitrosourea-Induced Adaptor Protein 2 Sigma Subunit 1 (Ap2s1) Mutations Establish Ap2s1 Loss-of-Function Mice (PMID: 29479578)
biological.summary: AP2σ (encoded by AP2S1) forms a heterotetrameric complex with AP2α, AP2β, and AP2μ subunits that is pivotal for clathrin-mediated endocytosis. Homozygous Ap2s1del17/del17 mice are embryonic lethal (E3.5-E9.5), indicating AP2σ has critical roles in embryonic patterning and organogenesis of heart, thyroid, liver, gut, lungs, pancreas, and neural systems.

biological.citation: GTPase GPN3 facilitates cell proliferation and migration in non-small cell lung cancer by impeding clathrin-mediated endocytosis of EGFR (PMID: 39893205)
biological.summary: AP2S1 is identified as a clathrin-mediated endocytosis-associated modulator that interacts with GPN3 and CLTA. GPN3 upregulation inhibits clathrin-coated pit invagination and decreases endocytic levels of EGFR, with AP2S1 playing a role in this regulatory mechanism.

biological.citation: High-Confidence Interactome for RNF41 Built on Multiple Orthogonal Assays (PMID: 29560723)
biological.summary: AP2S1 is identified as a novel RNF41 interaction partner through affinity purification-mass spectrometry, BioID, and Virotrap assays. RNF41 stabilizes and relocates AP2S1, and AP2S1 plays a role in leptin and LIF receptor signaling.
biological.sample_size: 175 candidate protein partners identified; 19 high-confidence hits

biological.citation: Synaptic Vesicle-Related Proteins and Ubiquilin 2 in Cortical Synaptosomes Mediate Cognitive Impairment in Vascular Dementia Rats (PMID: 38990251)
biological.summary: AP2S1 is identified as a hub protein in the synaptic vesicle cycle pathway and is significantly downregulated in synaptosomes of vascular dementia rats compared to controls. AP2S1 levels decreased in 2VO rats, suggesting a role in synaptic dysfunction associated with cognitive decline.
biological.sample_size: Male rats with bilateral common carotid artery occlusion

biological.citation: Familial Hypocalciuric Hypercalcemia Types 1 and 3 and Primary Hyperparathyroidism: Similarities and Differences (PMID: 26963950)
biological.summary: AP2S1 mutations cause familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia type 3 (FHH3) through loss-of-function mechanisms affecting calcium homeostasis. Three recurrent AP2S1 mutations were identified in 19 families; patients with FHH type 3 had higher plasma calcium concentrations and higher renal tubular calcium reabsorption than FHH type 1 patients.
biological.sample_size: 133 families; 52 FHH type 1, 22 FHH type 3, 60 PHPT patients

biological.citation: AP2S1 and GNA11 mutations - not a common cause of familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia (PMID: 27913609)
biological.summary: AP2S1 mutations at codon 15 (p.Arg15Leu and p.Arg15His) cause familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia type 3. In a cohort of 33 CASR-negative FHH patients, ~6% carried AP2S1 mutations, establishing AP2S1 as a causative gene for FHH3.
biological.sample_size: 33 CASR-negative FHH patients; control group of PHPT patients

biological.citation: Chapter 5: The roles of genetics in primary hyperparathyroidism (PMID: 39818301)
biological.summary: AP2S1 is included in the first-line panel of genes recommended for genetic screening in familial primary hyperparathyroidism and related conditions. AP2S1 mutations are recognized as a genetic cause of hereditary hyperparathyroidism requiring appropriate clinical management and genetic counseling.
